description: Ground-truth FEM for the finite 51 x 71 x 1.5 mm bonded PDMS pad (E = 1 MPa, linear elastic). Imposed displacement delta of a rigid platen/punch; all forces per unit delta. Frame: origin at the centre of the free face, x across (|x|<=25.5 mm), y along the finger (|y|<=35.5 mm), +z into the layer (free face z=0, bonded face z=1.5 mm). Force = force exerted by the platen ON the layer (+z = pressing into the skin). Taxel arrays are [j][i] (j = row along y, 0..6 from y=-35.5; i = column along x, 0..4 from x=-25.5).
accuracy_rule: value = Richardson extrapolation over nested levels m (h ~ 1/m); err = 1.25|Q* - Q_finest| (GCI), max'd with |full - mixed| when both forms exist. Taxel/profile arrays: finest level, with per-entry err = |Q_m3 - Q_m2| * max(1, 1.25/(r^p - 1)) using p of the global stiffness.

C1_pressure_method.source: J.M. Kelly, N.C. Van Engelen, 'Single series solution for the rectangular fiber-reinforced elastomeric isolator compression modulus', PEER Report 2015/03, sec. 2.1 eqs. (2.1)-(2.11) (parabolic bulging, sigma_xx=sigma_yy=sigma_zz=-p, compressibility tr eps = -p/K), here with rigid bonded faces (u1 = v1 = 0); https://peer.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/webpeer-2015-03_james_m._kelly_and_niel_c._van_engelen_.pdf
C1_pressure_method.equation: lap p - (12 G/(K t^2)) p = -12 G (delta/t)/t^2, p = 0 on the pad edges, F = int p dA

C4_axisymmetric.note: disc of radius R_out (25.5 mm = inscribed circle of the pad; 51 mm for the finite-size check), clamped back face, free lateral face; axi_fem.py
